changelog:
- Initial release of the train-style-model skill.
- Enables fine-tuning a reusable brand, style, or character model (LoRA) from 10–50 reference images.
- Submits an asynchronous training job and registers the trained model under a custom AIR.
- Supports generating consistent, on-brand imagery from any prompt using the new model.
- Includes detailed workflow and dataset guidance to ensure high-quality style transfer.
- For immediate consistent results without training, suggests using character-consistency instead.
